raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 (business date 2026-01-18) was delivered twice, at 02:00 and again at 05:00 ingest_ts. Its 652 rows are 326 txn_ids that each appear twice as identical copies, so every POSTED transaction for 2026-01-18 is doubled in silver and all gold aggregates downstream. The fix keeps only the most recent ingested version of each txn_id before applying the POSTED filter.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) = 1) d WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
